page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head top centre, page number top right. Heading "CAPVT XXXIX." centred, then the text, with a drop-capital opening the chapter. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: doctrina corporali ac spirituali: ac propterea iustissimis de causis per prophetam fuisse huic historiae admixtum, maxime vero, quia conducit ad percipiendum verum ipsius historiae usum.

Et ait Iesaia.) Pertinet istud ad historiam, quae scriptum seu carme praecesserit. Non fuisset autem opus, post verbum Dei addere malagma ulceri: sed fit istud ad declarandum, ordinata media non esse in necessitate contemnenda. quamobrem commendatur hic usus medicinae.

Dixitq; Hizkijahu.) Debent haec accipi ut magno affectu & summa cum admiratione pronunciata, quasi dicat: Quàm admirandum est hoc signum, quòd restitutus valetudini ascendam in domum Domini, ubi cum caeteris colam Deum, audiam Dei verbum, &c.In Hebraeo מָה [?] etiam admirantis est, ut Psal.8. Quàm admirabile est nomen tuum. Item, Quàm dilecta tabernacula.
main_text.head: CAPUT XXXIX.
main_text.p: Misit autem in tempore illo Merodach Balædan, filius Balędan, rex Babel, literas & munus ad Hizkijahu, postquam audivit quòd aegrotasset & convaluisset. Laetatusq; est Hizkijahu de eis, & ostendit illis domum thesauri sui, argentum & aurum atq; aromata, unguentum optimum, & omnem domum armorum eius, & quic-

page.notes: The Hebrew word after "Hebraeo" is printed in a small form and is only partly legible; the reading given is a best guess and is marked [?]. The "Quàm" words in the notes carry underlining, not reproduced. Printed forms "Balædan" and "Balędan" are kept as they appear. Running head and page number are printed at the top; catchword "quid" and signature "B 5" at the foot.
